name: Cohort (d20pfsrd)
body:
You gain a faithful companion.

Prerequisites: Character level 3rd.

Benefit: You gain a Cohort, as described in the Leadership feat.

Special: This feat does not entitle the character to receive followers, nor does the character gain a second cohort if she later takes the Leadership feat.
